purpose: Compare a fixed total island-unit budget allocated to deep within-archipelago sampling versus replication across independently evolved archipelagos.

scenarios.description: Twenty-four island units concentrated in two independent systems.
Twenty-four island units distributed across four independent systems.
Twenty-four island units distributed across eight independent systems.
Twenty-four island units distributed across twelve independent systems.
Twenty-four independent systems sampled once each; an upper-bound replication diagnostic rather than a literal field recommendation.

claim_boundary: All effects and variance components are synthetic. Archipelago means are equal-weight diagnostics, not a final random-effects meta-analysis or an empirical sample-size recommendation.
